title: Choose the visual world for IPS
question: The roll assigned Safety Signage. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Wet Floor: The Safety-Sign Standard
options.lineage: Australian workplace safety signage and the yellow wet-floor A-frame
options.thesis: IPS becomes the safety sign: black-on-caution-yellow, pictograms and standard sign grammar that make trust visible.
options.viewport: A giant 3D caution-yellow A-frame unfolds and spins in mid-air, with the headline set as sign panels. Get Quote is a yellow sign-plate button.
options.risk: Can read as construction or industrial if the type and spacing go clumsy; it needs editorial restraint.

raised.raise: Strict ink count: only the five signage colours, flat with no tints or gradients, held across the whole page.
Every service carries a timestamp, like a cleaning log signed off at 02:14.
Measured grid: every panel and number snaps to a visible ruler grid, like sign spec sheets.
One control transforms the whole: pulling the yellow quote tab unfolds the A-frame into the form.

options.label: Colour-Code System
options.lineage: the cleaning industry's red/yellow/blue/green colour-coded cloths and buckets
options.thesis: The industry's own colour code, red for toilets, yellow for basins, blue for general, green for kitchens, becomes the brand system.
options.viewport: Four 3D colour-coded buckets orbit, cloths fly in and wipe the headline clean.
options.risk: Familiar: four primaries are where many service brands land, and it could look like kids' branding.

options.label: Risograph
options.case: Fuses poorly: facility managers buying trust don't identify with zine culture.
options.risk: Reads as a hobby, not a contractor.
options.kept: Total commitment to a strict ink count.

options.label: Brine Calendar
options.thesis: Services as a maturing shelf of jars.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the metaphor fights the product.
options.kept: Day-count and timestamp logging on every entry.

options.label: Oscilloscope
options.case: Fuses poorly: neon-on-black is the AI default and off-audience.
options.kept: Everything measured against a visible grid.

options.label: Drawcord Cape
options.viewport: Black semicircle rising into a shell.
options.case: Fuses poorly: luxury fashion is off-audience for contract cleaning.
options.kept: A single control that transforms the whole surface.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean blue-and-white commercial cleaning site, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Photo hero of a crew in a bright office, stats bar, service grid.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every Perth competitor by design.
